results.name: projection-of-public-school-headcount-enrolment
results.notes:
Projection of Public School Headcount Enrolment

NOTE:

•	The current methodology for forecasts published 2022 and later use historic enrolment patterns and estimated input drivers of student demographic, migration and grade to grade transition patterns to forecast the number of students enrolled in each school district.

•	All headcount forecasts published before 2022 use a combination of the Census population forecasts to forecast the number of students enrolled in each school district.
